description: This file defines the PasswordExpirationService class which manages password expiration messages and configuration within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: PasswordExpirationService
classes.description: A service class handling password expiration messaging and configuration updates in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the service with configuration and language string data.

methods.name: getExpirationMessage
methods.description: Generates and returns a message indicating password expiration status with a link to password management.

methods.name: setExpiration
methods.description: Resets the password expiration setting in the configuration and writes it to the config file.
